# What is WordPress?

WordPress is free, open source software for building websites. You manage everything in your browser.

## What you can build

- A blog or a personal site.
- A store, a portfolio, a membership site.

> [!NOTE]
> WordPress.org and WordPress.com are different things. See [Install WordPress](./install-wordpress.md#choose-a-host).
